title: plantago weldenii var. commutata
intro: Plantago weldenii var. commutata, commonly known as Plantago lanceolata, is a species of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Plantago lanceolata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
